name: Trudd's Strength
text:
This filigree depiction of a warhammer in front of a kite-shaped shield grants you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and to Intimidation checks to Coerce. Additionally, once per day, the filigree symbol can be activated to protect your allies.

Activate—Protect the Clan! 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect Protective energy releases in a 10-foot emanation, granting a +1 status bonus to Armor Class to all allies within the area. The bonus lasts for 1 minute.

Effect: Trudd's Strength
